announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: Final Results follow the September capital raise and August resource updates. Shareholders should watch for financial performance against these recent milestones.

announcements.headline: Oversubscribed Placing of £1.5m
announcements.insight: A fundraise follows recent resource upgrades. This capital injection supports the Queensland exploration programme.

announcements.headline: Upgraded JORC Resource at Kathleen Valley
announcements.insight: The upgraded resource follows the move to 100% ownership in August. This suggests increased value for the Queensland project.

announcements.headline: Highly Positive Geophysics Results from Monal
announcements.insight: Positive geophysics results follow the August drilling update, suggesting continued exploration progress at the Monal project.

announcements.headline: Queensland Exploration Programme & Drilling Update
announcements.insight: Mila Resources advances its Queensland project to 100% ownership with a new drilling update. This follows the August acquisition and June IP survey.

announcements.headline: Mila moves to 100% Ownership in Queensland
announcements.insight: Mila Resources achieves full ownership of its Queensland asset. This follows the June IP survey and management options, indicating progression in project development.

announcements.headline: Management Share Options
announcements.insight: Management share options were granted. This follows the commencement of an IP survey at the Monal Au-Cu Project in June.

announcements.headline: Commencement of IP Survey at Monal Au-Cu Project
announcements.insight: Mila Resources has commenced an IP survey at its Monal Au-Cu Project. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent exploration results or development milestones.
